title: Story premise EDU078: The Hitchhiking Seed Trail
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (environment/ecology). Hook: How did the next patch begin so far away? Takeaway/theme: Species movement can involve human transport pathways as well as nearby spread.
description: A habitat educator wants to explain how an introduced plant might reach a new site, but a map showing only established patches misses transport links. A reviewed fictionalized pathway highlights prevention questions without teaching removal or dispersal.
